_template: FIND-106 template_version 1.0.0, docs_verified 2026-09-17 (https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks). Copy to <project>/.cursor/hooks.json (runs from project root). Launcher: pwsh -NoProfile -File <REPO>/vanta-mcp-local.ps1 -DbPath <DB_PATH>. Secrets: session env only.

_policy.sessionStart: memory_recall scope=agent top_k=5 -> additionalContext; empty injects NOTHING
_policy.beforeSubmitPrompt: memory_recall query=<verbatim user text> scope=agent top_k=5
_policy.stop: auto-capture via thread_send role+content; proxy-turns via inbox, never auto-promote

_scripts: No wrapper scripts needed: every hook invokes the pwsh launcher directly (same pattern as claude/codex templates). The launcher starts the MCP server on stdio; the agent issues memory_recall/thread_send. Exit 0 = use JSON output; other non-zero = fail-open (Cursor default).
